disputes.intro: Luural jeyi ngal ƴettu-ɗaa ngam soodooɓe ɓe njaɓaaka ko duppiteeji. Admin Leadrat ina ƴeewtoo heen kala.

disputes.withdrawConfirm: Ittu luural maa ngam {{name}} ? Jeyi jooni oo ina heddii no woniri nii.
disputes.raiseHint: So tawii oo soodoowo arii e maa ko adii, paamtin ko waɗi ɗum. Admin Leadrat gooto maa ƴeewto ɗum; so ɓe pellitii e dow maa, ardorde ndee winnditaama e maa.
disputes.reasonLabel: Hol ko waɗi oo soodoowo ko maa?
disputes.notProtected: Hay gooto jogaaki ndeenka e oo soodoowo ngam ndee eɓɓoore kadi - aɗa waawi winnditaade ardorde ndee jooni.
